Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.parser

Class BPMNExtensionExtractor

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.parser.BPMNExtensionExtractor
public class BPMNExtensionExtractor extends Object
Extracts Zeebe/Camunda extension element properties from BPMN model elements into the Orchest domain node model. Handles IO mappings, task definitions, event properties, user task assignments, and multi-instance configurations.
